component.name: FFmpeg Studio
استوديو FFmpeg
component.summary: Modern, fast native GUI for FFmpeg built with Rust and GTK4
واجهة رسومية حديثة وسريعة لأداة FFmpeg مبنية بلغة Rust و GTK4

description.p: FFmpeg Studio is a lightweight, native desktop interface for FFmpeg written in Rust with GTK4 and Libadwaita. It provides instant media inspection, automatic GPU encoder detection (NVENC, AMF, QSV, VA-API), MKV/MP4 subtitle and font muxing, and built-in zscale upscaling presets while keeping the full FFmpeg command editable.

description.p: Added zscale 4K/2K/1080p presets, automatic GPU encoder detection, 10-bit source depth preservation, internal subtitle burn-in support, and BT.709 color metadata preservation.
